Ari: Heads-up — Veridian QBR Thursday. Finance requested one clear spend forecast, onboarding status, and any renewal flags.
Zoe: On it. I'll pull 45-day token history + a 2-week burn projection. Noticed a cron hitting /v1/embeddings around 03:00 UTC daily.
Max: Quick snapshot: current billing period tokens = 64.1M, avg daily = 2.1M, recent pilot spike ~+48% last 7 days.
Len: At current ramp they cross soft threshold in ~12 days. Options: temporary credits, short-term commit uplift, or per-route caps.
FinOpsBot: alert: Veridian retainer usage at 69% of committed for period ending 2026-03-20.
Ari: Renewal conversation — product adoption looks strong but finance cares about predictability.
Zoe: Renewal risk = medium. We should phrase the commercial ask as predictability for finance, value for product.
Max: Draft ask: "Recommend 12% temporary retainer uplift for next quarter with a 30-day review; include a 45-min enablement session for their devs to optimize embed calls."
Len: Provisioned emergency credits: `45k credits | expires in 11d`. Note added on the account. Drafting an SE checklist: 1) enable prefix caching, 2) shift nightly batches off-peak, 3) evaluate embed dim reduction.
Zoe: I'll export per-route P95 latency and token distribution (14d) and drop CSV into the deck for a cost/latency tradeoff slide.
Max: Feedback Qs for the QBR: 1) "Would you prefer predictable monthly spend or lower expected costs with occasional throttles?" 2) "Would a short enablement session to tune embeddings be valuable?"
Ari: Also add an appendix scenario: cost impact if embed dim reduced 1536->1024 and if batch jobs move to off-peak.
Len: Drafted auto-throttle policy: throttle embedding route above 82% retainer with a 48h notice; added to deck appendix.
FinOpsBot: note: invoices and commit history at /billing/veridian/ (2026-02..2026-03).
Ari: Action items recap: Zoe - CSV export & P95 (due Wed), Max - deck + ask blurb & scenarios (due Thu EOD), Len - confirm credits & policy draft, Ari - schedule QBR and invite finance lead. Using this thread as canonical QBR ops for Veridian. :white_check_mark:
